description:
The key driver for the proposals are to deliver a single decant solution for existing residents of the Estate in a new high quality building on the car park site to enable redevelopment of the existing London City Shopping Centre and existing housing for new, high quality residential to deliver a significant uplift in affordable housing, new public realm and routes through the Site and new town centre uses to enhance the Whitecross Street Local Shopping Area.

The proposals include new homes and will re-provide homes for the existing residents, including 85 replacement homes, 49 intermediate homes, 108 social homes, and 243 market homes. The Applicant is engaging with Islington as the social landlord to begin preparing a landlord offer to be put to a ballot – targeting the autumn 2026.
